prompt: Where will the volunteers try the revised arrangement?
promptZh: 志工會在哪裡試用調整後的做法？

options.text: On a wide stretch by the bakery.
options.zh: 在麵包店旁一段較寬的路上。
options.whyZh: 男方指定先在麵包店旁的寬路段測試布帶。
要在店旁的路段試，不是在店內。
會先在麵包店旁測試，之後才抬到橋下。

options.text: Across the street at the finish.
options.whyZh: 今年不在終點把橫幅拉過整條街，測試地點也不是終點。

explanationZh: 男方指定先在麵包店旁的寬路段測試布帶。
evidence: Let’s attach short fabric ties to the bottom corners. Each of the two people carrying the banner can hold one. Try them on the wide stretch by the bakery before we take it under the bridge.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Let’s attach short fabric ties to the bottom corners. Each of the two people carrying the banner can hold one. Try them on the wide stretch by the bakery before we take it under the bridge.

vocabulary.note: stretch 指一段連續路段；此處是在麵包店旁試走。
